name: @vidya-contact/root
description: Standalone Complaints & Help module for Vidya Learning. React Native app + NestJS/Fastify API + PostgreSQL.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix api install && npm --prefix mobile install
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,mobile "npm --prefix api start" "npm --prefix mobile run web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:api && npm run typecheck:mobile
